statusDetail: Coverage complete. The target is a single hash-routed OEM browser start portal; no additional internal routes, sitemap, or links were exposed. The public entry rendered a live failure state, which was audited rather than treated as a bot block.

page.framework: Vue (compiled Vux/Vue-style scoped CSS and #app shell)
page.notes: Single #/ route. Desktop and mobile, search input state, forced colors, dark/reduced-motion preferences, no-JS crawler view, network/security, performance, and repeated input memory behaviour were covered. No distinct listing/detail/account/checkout route exists in the rendered DOM; robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404.

paths.description: Public entry at a wide viewport, representing desktop form-factor adaptation.
Primary OEM start-page route and live failure/recovery state at mobile size.
Representative primary interaction: focus and type into search; inspect submission control semantics and state.
Raw HTML and JavaScript-disabled crawler representation of the only public route.
Global load, performance, transport, headers, cookies, third parties, credentials, assets, and runtime health.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The dark-mode capture is pixel-identical to the light mobile capture and computed color-scheme is normal; both stylesheets contain no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens with a usable light fallback.

findings.summary: Recovery and search state changes do not guide keyboard attention
findings.evidence: The error recovery is a non-focusable DIV and the search button is a non-focusable DIV; the search-flow probe leaves focus on the 20px input with no programmatic cue to the failed content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic buttons/links, move or announce focus when state changes, and expose clear directional recovery.

findings.summary: Desktop is a stretched mobile layout rather than an adapted form factor
findings.evidence: At 1440px, the phone-specific message and sparse mobile controls stretch across the full width while content stays tiny; CSS inspection found no container queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce responsive component containers and cap/recompose the start-page layout for wide screens.

findings.summary: Primary controls are too small and not keyboard operable
findings.evidence: The only focusable control is a 170x20 input with outline none; search and Refresh are DIVs without role/tabindex, so keyboard users cannot activate them.
findings.suggestedFix: Use button elements for search and Refresh, provide visible :focus-visible styles, and make targets at least 24x24 CSS px (prefer 44x44 for primary touch actions).

findings.summary: The entry page does not communicate a working purpose
findings.evidence: Both viewports lead with a location instruction, empty shortcut placeholders, and “Unable to open web page”; there is no heading or descriptive primary action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a clear start-page heading and working search/news shortcuts even when weather or personalisation APIs fail.

findings.summary: The public entry experience fails its core load and search action is pointer-only
findings.evidence: The init endpoint returns {retcode:20000}; the rendered page says “Unable to open web page”. Search submission is a DIV unavailable to keyboard users.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the init response/handling so core content loads independently of device metadata, and implement search with a semantic form and submit button.

findings.summary: Failure recovery is vague and inaccessible
findings.evidence: The page gives no failure cause or alternate path, and Refresh is a non-focusable DIV with no role or keyboard activation.
findings.suggestedFix: Explain what failed, preserve search access, and provide a semantic Retry button with an announced loading/error/result state.

findings.summary: LCP is slow under Lighthouse mobile conditions
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.6s (score 0.17), although the unthrottled trace measured 1.67s; the error illustration became the LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the LCP resource discoverable in initial HTML, prioritise it when it is meaningful, and avoid delaying core content on device/API initialisation.

findings.summary: Critical delivery and cache hygiene are weak
findings.evidence: HAR found ten resources without useful cache headers and an uncompressed 40KB ad SDK; Lighthouse says the LCP image is not initial-document discoverable or fetch-prioritised.
findings.suggestedFix: Add immutable caching for hashed assets, compression for text, and expose/prioritise the LCP candidate without blocking core content.

findings.summary: Unused ad and analytics JavaScript dominates the small page
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 323KiB unused JavaScript; HAR shows 468,797 of 639,530 transferred bytes are third-party, led by DoubleClick and GTM.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential ad/analytics vendors, conditionally load remaining scripts after core content, and split the page bundle.

findings.summary: The accessibility tree lacks names and semantics
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 11 images without alt, an unlabeled search input, and no main landmark; Refresh/search actions are generic DIVs.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful or empty alt text, a label for search, semantic buttons, and a main landmark.

findings.summary: Status text fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured contrast ratios 2.84:1 and 2.92:1 for the location instruction and error message against white, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use darker status text tokens that meet at least 4.5:1 in normal mode while retaining forced-colors support.

findings.summary: There is no semantic structure or visible keyboard focus
findings.evidence: The page has no headings or landmarks; focusing the only input yields outline none and no box shadow, while action DIVs cannot receive focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical h1/main structure and visible :focus-visible treatment; use native controls in reading order.

findings.summary: Tiny low-contrast status text harms readability
findings.evidence: The location text is 13px at 2.84:1 and the error text is 14px at 2.92:1; on desktop it remains visually tiny amid a very wide canvas.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase status text size/line-height, constrain line length, and use compliant color tokens.

findings.summary: The viewport disables zoom and the primary input target is only 20px high
findings.evidence: Viewport content includes maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse fails meta-viewport and the focus probe measures a 20px-high search input.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no/maximum-scale, preserve reflow at zoom, and enlarge interactive targets.

findings.summary: The page throws during load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading exposeLink) in home.aa123ac2.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Null-check the ad/link object and prevent optional integrations from throwing during core page setup.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions and one is oversized
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 11/11 images without width/height; the 548px error PNG is displayed at 180px and has no responsive source.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and serve an appropriately sized modern-format error image.

findings.summary: Geolocation is requested on page load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse geolocation-on-start fails at home.aa123ac2.js; the page immediately instructs users to enable positioning before an intentional user action.
findings.suggestedFix: Request location only after a user activates a clearly explained weather feature; keep search and core content independent.

findings.summary: Metadata is generic and incomplete
findings.evidence: The title is only “Homepage” and no meta description is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a unique descriptive title and concise description explaining the Vivo start/search experience.

findings.summary: The page has no crawlable links and blocks user zoom
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM contains zero anchors, while the viewport disables scaling; robots.txt returns a branded nginx 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href links for shortcuts, permit zoom, and publish a valid robots.txt.

findings.summary: Canonical, sitemap, and language indexing signals are absent
findings.evidence: No canonical or hreflang is present; robots.txt and sitemap.xml both return 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical and locale signals, plus consistent robots.txt and sitemap.xml for the public page.

findings.summary: The public organization/start page has no share metadata
findings.evidence: Probe found zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite a public branded start page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and minimal Organization/WebSite JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: Client credentials and cookie/header defenses are unsafe
findings.evidence: The bundle exposes an API_KEY plus SECRET used to derive weather access keys. All four cookies use SameSite=None and three analytics cookies lack Secure; CSP and HSTS are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Rotate the exposed credential, move request signing server-side, set Secure/SameSite cookies, and deploy CSP and HSTS.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad vendors dominate network use without visible consent
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found nine third-party origins including DoubleClick, GTM and Google Analytics; HAR attributes 73% of transferred bytes to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary trackers and ad bidders, gate optional analytics on informed consent, and batch/minimise telemetry.

findings.summary: Location permission is requested out of context on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse directly flags geolocation-on-start before the user chooses weather or location functionality; authentication is not present and does not affect this failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer geolocation until a user invokes weather/location and explain the benefit immediately before the browser prompt.

findings.summary: The response omits all inspected browser defense headers
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP (including frame-ancestors), HSTS, nosniff, strict referrer policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core content disappears without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability found 0% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML; the crawler screenshot is blank while the browser view contains the error/search UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the core search/navigation and failure content, then hydrate enhancements progressively.

findings.summary: Optional integrations can break runtime behaviour
findings.evidence: A null exposeLink access throws during load and the init API returns only retcode 20000, leaving empty shortcut placeholders and a failed shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Isolate optional ads/weather/news, guard null data, and render stable fallback shortcuts/search when integrations fail.

findings.summary: The app-like portal has no install or offline baseline
findings.evidence: DOM/runtime probes found no manifest, no service-worker controller, and raw HTML contains no usable fallback content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a manifest and service worker only if installability is intended; regardless, cache and serve an offline search/navigation fallback.

findings.summary: The live API failure collapses the page into a dead-end shell
findings.evidence: The init response is {retcode:20000}; the page renders “Unable to open web page” with a non-semantic Refresh DIV and no alternative core route.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle API/network errors per feature, keep core navigation usable, and offer an accessible retry with actionable diagnostics.

findings.summary: Document language is missing
findings.evidence: Both DOM probe and Lighthouse show an empty html lang attribute; assistive technology cannot determine the English page language.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an accurate lang attribute from the active locale and use dir/logical properties for translated layouts.

findings.summary: Search disables browser input assistance
findings.evidence: The only search input explicitly sets autocomplete=off and has no label or placeholder, reducing recognition and browser assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Label the search field and use an appropriate autocomplete/search configuration instead of blanket autocomplete=off.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not resolution-aware
findings.evidence: All 11 images lack dimensions; the 548px PNG error asset is rendered at 180px with no srcset and no modern-format alternative.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve right-sized WebP/AVIF where appropriate and include dimensions/responsive sources.

findings.summary: The failed page still loads substantial advertising and analytics work
findings.evidence: HAR transfers 468,797 third-party bytes and Lighthouse identifies 323KiB unused JavaScript while the core content remains an error shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not load ad bidders/analytics until core content succeeds and a relevant surface needs them; conditionally defer background work.

findings.summary: Third parties consume 73% of page bytes
findings.evidence: Eleven third-party requests transfer 468,797 of 639,530 bytes; DoubleClick alone transfers 262,404 bytes on a sparse failed page.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party byte budget, remove redundant ad/analytics vendors, and lazy-load any remaining integration after user value.

taskList.title: Restore a resilient core start/search experience
Replace DIV actions with labelled keyboard and touch controls
Remove exposed signing secrets and deploy browser security policies
Fix language, contrast, zoom, alt text, and landmarks
Server-render crawlable core content and complete metadata
Improve LCP, cache/compress hashed assets, and right-size images
Defer geolocation until an intentional weather action
Add preference-driven dark colors and wide-layout adaptation
Label and re-enable appropriate search input assistance
